name: std-learn-arrangement
description: Generic build-an-ordering-then-grade instrument — a config-declared roster of items (each with a correct position index and an optional hint) is tapped one at a time from a remaining-items button row onto a growing sequence of ordered slots rendered on a math-canvas; a tapped item becomes unavailable, an Undo button removes the last placement, and once every slot is filled a Check button grades the arrangement with per-slot correct/wrong coloring, a score readout, and a verdict badge. Retry clears the placements and keeps the same roster. Item vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any ordering task (process steps, chronology, procedure, ranking) standalone. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

emits.description: The grading result after Check — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: arrangement graded, order checked, score, running score

emits.description: Signals the arrangement was cleared back to empty by Retry — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
Fired when a Check grades the arrangement fully correct — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
emits.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, all correct

events.name: Mode Selected
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: Place
events.description: Learner tapped an unplaced item, appending it to the end of the built sequence; the item becomes unavailable in the remaining-items row.

events.name: Undo
events.description: Learner removed the most recently placed item, returning it to the remaining-items row and clearing any prior grading.

events.name: Check
events.description: Learner asked to grade the built sequence once every slot is filled; each slot is verdicted against its item's declared correct position.

events.name: Retry
events.description: Learner cleared every placement and restarted the arrangement from an empty sequence, keeping the same item roster.

events.name: Arrangement Checked
events.description: The grading result after Check — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: arrangement graded, order checked, score, running score

events.name: Arrangement Reset
events.description: Signals the arrangement was cleared back to empty by Retry — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

events.name: Learn Round Complete
events.description: Fired when a Check grades the arrangement fully correct — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
events.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, all correct

items.label: Items
items.description: Roster of items to order; each carries its label, its zero-based correct position in the finished sequence, and an optional hint shown beneath its button while unplaced.
items.synonyms: item, step, stage, sequence, order, ranking, procedure

emptySlotColor.label: Empty Slot Color
emptySlotColor.description: Fill color for a slot with no item placed yet.

pendingColor.label: Pending Slot Color
pendingColor.description: Fill color for a filled slot before grading.

incorrectColor.label: Incorrect Slot Color
incorrectColor.description: Fill color for a filled slot whose item does not match its correct position, once graded.

correctColor.label: Correct Slot Color
correctColor.description: Fill color for a filled slot whose item matches its correct position, once graded.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.
